summary: First-run frontend-only (Expo web preview) smoke of KosManager offline app at 390x844. Tested Dashboard stats + hero + arrears + quick actions, Rooms CRUD + duplicate guard + filter chips, Tenants CRUD + search + room-assignment, Payment flow (prefill = rent, partial => DP receipt), Finance tab (summary, segmented tabs, month nav, add expense updates expense/net), Settings (profile save, PIN setup, lock on reload, wrong-PIN error, correct-PIN unlock, remove PIN), and JSON backup export (download triggered, no error toast). Core flows all passed. One deprecated web warning only.

issues: Period on dashboard reads 'Oktober 2026' because container clock is Oct 2026 - cosmetic only; no code fix needed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - web-only React Native deprecation warnings; harmless but should be migrated. Reference: library-wide (likely in /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx and /app/frontend/src/theme.ts shadow styles).

action_items: (Low) Replace RN shadow* style props with boxShadow for web and migrate pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to clear console deprecation warnings.
(Info) PIN confirm step auto-submits once 4 digits are entered - test scripts should not rely on setup-pin-submit for the confirmation step; current behavior is correct and user-friendly.
critical_code_review_comments: Rooms list uses prefix testID 'room-card-{id}' and 'room-card-{id}-status' - selecting with [data-testid^=room-card-] matches both; benign but note for future tests to filter out '-status' suffix.

(tabs)/_layout.tsx bottom tabs are hidden when inside non-tab routes (tenant/[id], room/[id], settings, forms) - this is expected Expo Router behavior; UI tests must use goto() or back nav instead of clicking tabs from inside stack screens.
Dashboard period uses system date (Oktober 2026 shown) which is fine, but if the container clock differs from user device clock, Keuangan screen may default to a different month than user expects.
seed_data_creation: Added Room A1 (Rp 1.500.000) and Tenant 'Budi Santoso' (081234567890) assigned to A1 with entry 2026-01-05, 1 partial payment Rp 500.000 (DP) with receipt No. KW/202610/0001, and 1 expense Rp 250.000. PIN 1234 was set then removed in the final cleanup pass (left set in the final isolated PIN-session test; data is in localStorage['kosmanager_web_db']).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser isolates localStorage per automation tool call; to test PIN lock-on-reload you MUST do setup + reload + unlock inside a SINGLE mcp_browser_automation script. Bottom tabs (data-testid tab-index/tab-rooms/tab-tenants/tab-finance) are only visible on the (tabs) screens - use absolute URL navigation (page.goto('/rooms')) to switch when inside detail or form screens. Receipt status for partial payment is literally 'DP / BELUM LUNAS'. Backup export filename is kosmanager-backup-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.json. All critical flows passed; only cosmetic RNW deprecation warnings remain.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. Earlier test iteration appeared to show 'tenant saved without room' and 'room not Terisi' but RCA revealed the tenant-room Chips first option is 'tenant-room-none' (Belum ada); selecting index 0 picked 'none'. After choosing a non-'none' chip, room assignment, Terisi status, and arrears/receipt all behaved correctly.
